category_title: Students who experience academic belittlement or low expectations from instructors based on their identity
scenario_title: Peer microaggressions during small group lab work
minimal_context: The student is working on a project in a small group discussion with two lab partners.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's check in on your small group discussion. How are you and your two lab partners progressing on the project?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It is not going well. My two lab partners, one White and one Middle Eastern, kept telling terrible jokes about Chinese people, thinking that I was Chinese.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Did you try correcting them so you can get back to the lab work?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: When they finally asked, I told them I was half Japanese, so the jokes changed to ones about Japanese culture. They NEVER quit.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to focus on the project and let them talk among themselves.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I feel really uncomfortable even to speak, as I am the only Asian kid in that group. I am ‘invisible’ to them when they are talking to each other.
